title: OZ Varieties
summary: States that OZ Varieties, a United Exports company, is the sub-licensee facilitating licensed production of the proprietary OZblu varieties, and that United Exports holds the exclusive right to sub-license production of and market OZblu.
why_it_matters: The company's own description of its rights position. It confirms United Exports as an exclusive sub-licensor and marketer, not as the owner of the underlying breeding rights.

reading.rationale: Defines the rights chain for the whole OZblu portfolio.

commercial_position.rationale: Exclusive marketing rights are a real commercial asset even without genetics ownership.
